dashboard.label: Rainfall Totals
dashboard.description: ZENTRA Cloud charts Precipitation as rainfall during each 15-minute interval. This view keeps those samples and sums value by logger_day (the date in datetime) so customers can see daily and weekly rain. Zeros are dry intervals and do not change the total.

search.query: `zentra_weather_search` | stats count by device_sn | sort device_sn

single.title: Rain this period (sum of 15-minute samples)

search.query: | stats sum(value) as rainfall latest(units) as units | eval value = if(isnotnull(rainfall), round(rainfall, 3)." ".coalesce(units,""), "n/a") | fields value

single.option: not a single ZENTRA chart point — this is accumulated rainfall

single.title: Rain today (logger calendar)

search.query: `zentra_interval_precip` device_sn="$device_sn$" | where logger_day=strftime(now(), "%Y-%m-%d") | stats sum(value) as rainfall latest(units) as units | eval value = if(isnotnull(rainfall), round(rainfall, 3)." ".coalesce(units,""), "n/a") | fields value

single.option: sum of Precipitation where logger_day is today

single.title: Rain this week (logger calendar)

search.query: `zentra_interval_precip` device_sn="$device_sn$" | eval logger_week=strftime(strptime(logger_day, "%Y-%m-%d"), "%Y-%W") | eval this_week=strftime(now(), "%Y-%W") | where logger_week=this_week | stats sum(value) as rainfall latest(units) as units | eval value = if(isnotnull(rainfall), round(rainfall, 3)." ".coalesce(units,""), "n/a") | fields value

single.option: sum of this week's logger_day samples

search.query: `zentra_precip_rain` device_sn="$device_sn$" | table datetime, logger_day, value, units | sort - datetime

chart.title: Daily rainfall (sum of that day's 15-minute samples)

search.query: | eval _time=strptime(logger_day, "%Y-%m-%d") | timechart span=1d sum(value) as daily_rainfall

chart.title: Weekly rainfall (sum of that week's 15-minute samples)

search.query: | eval _time=strptime(logger_day, "%Y-%m-%d") | timechart span=1w sum(value) as weekly_rainfall

table.title: Daily rainfall table — sum Precipitation by logger_day

search.query: | stats sum(value) as rainfall latest(units) as units count as interval_samples sum(eval(if(value>0,1,0))) as wet_intervals by logger_day, device_sn | eval rainfall=round(rainfall, 3) | sort - logger_day | rename logger_day as day, rainfall as rainfall_total
